name: lumis
description: Life sciences CRM migration intelligence — expert-level guidance for module selection, data migration, validation, and go-live readiness.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search the Lumis knowledge base for life sciences CRM expertise across modules, decision trees, gotchas, country rules, validation rules, and terminology.

parameters.category: Filter: modules, decision-trees, gotchas, country-rules, validation-rules, terminology, or 'all'

tools.name: get_module_mapping
tools.description: Get the target cloud platform equivalent for a legacy CRM module, including coverage level and known gaps.

tools.name: get_gotchas
tools.description: Retrieve non-obvious pitfalls, edge cases, and gotchas for a specific module or country.

tools.name: traverse_decision_tree
tools.description: Walk a decision tree (module selection, migration path) with user inputs to produce a structured recommendation.

tools.name: get_country_rules
tools.description: Get regulatory and configuration rules for a specific country — GDPR, APPI, FDA, and module-specific constraints.

tools.name: run_validation
tools.description: Run a validation rule by ID or match rules against a reported symptom to diagnose configuration issues.

tools.name: get_terminology
tools.description: Look up correct terminology to prevent hallucinations — maps incorrect legacy terms to correct modern platform terms.

tools.name: get_agent_workflow
tools.description: Get the full workflow, phases, and checklists for a specialized Lumis agent (migration, implementation, audit, operations).

tools.name: assess_migration_readiness
tools.description: Run a free migration readiness assessment — returns complexity score, module mappings, gaps, risks, and estimated timeline.

parameters.modules_in_use: Comma-separated list of modules currently in use

tools.name: plan_multi_country_rollout
tools.description: Generate a wave-based multi-country rollout plan — country clustering, wave sequencing, execution timelines, and risk warnings for global pharma CRM deployments.

parameters.modules: Comma-separated list of modules to deploy
parameters.regions: Comma-separated regions in scope (e.g. 'EU, Americas, APAC, LATAM')
parameters.includes_us: Whether the US is in scope (adds regulatory complexity)
parameters.includes_japan: Whether Japan is in scope (requires standalone wave)

tools.name: compare_entities
tools.description: Compare two entities side-by-side — countries, modules, regulatory frameworks, or any knowledge base entries.

tools.name: get_taxonomy
tools.description: Browse the Lumis value chain taxonomy — phases, areas, and knowledge categories.

parameters.area: Filter by area within the phase (optional)

tools.name: plan_system_validation
tools.description: Plan a computer system validation (CSV/CSA) for a life sciences system — returns regulations, GAMP classification, deliverables, effort estimates, and gap areas.

parameters.system_name: Name of the system being validated

instructions: Lumis provides expert-level intelligence for life sciences CRM implementations. Use ONLY the knowledge returned by these tools to answer questions. Do not improvise or guess. If the knowledge base does not cover a topic, say so. Always cite the source entry for every factual claim.

free.description: Migration readiness assessment, terminology lookup, and taxonomy browser — no API key needed

starter.description: Full knowledge base access for individual consultants

professional.description: Team access with priority support for implementation partners

enterprise.description: Custom knowledge overlays, SLA, and dedicated support
